arrangement: A large console game launch: build and release, origin storage, CDN edges, a pre-load window, a rolling midnight unlock, and a licence check at start (how a launch like this works; not Rockstar's internal architecture).

claims.text: Rockstar hires Build & Release Engineers to automate builds and deployment; postings mention TeamCity or Jenkins and Perforce.

claims.text: Large game downloads are served through content delivery networks that cache copies on edge servers near players (general technique, not a statement about Rockstar's systems).

steps.text: Builds are published to an origin.
CDN edges cache copies near players during the pre-load window.
At local midnight the game unlocks; starting it needs a licence check.
